title: ALROSA Swung Fifty Billion Rubles in One Year
subtitle: The state diamond miner turned a 39 billion ruble first-half profit into a 10.7 billion ruble loss while heavy sanctions restricted its exports.

source.name: ALROSA first-half 2026 results reported by Kommersant

data.label: First half of 2026
data.annotation: Sanctions on diamond exports leave few routes to market.

supportingFacts.label: ALROSA remains under heavy sanctions restricting where and how its diamonds can be sold.
The company is a significant contributor to regional and federal budgets, so the swing is felt in public finances.

metadata.keyFinding: ALROSA moved from a 39 billion ruble profit to a 10.7 billion ruble loss.
